dialog.content: Hi there. You wouldn't happen to be an Ultimate by chance?
..Hm? Two other people? How truly unexpected.
I may be an ultimate, who's asking?
Oh, I'm Shion Fumihiro. I'm an Ultimate Spy. And Rikuno here is an Ultimate Mercenary.
Ah, really. Well in that case.
I am Noriyuki Wato, the ultimate guitarist.
But if we're all ultimates, why were we brought here? That's what I'm trying to find out.
But what do you know about this place, anything?
I honestly have no clue, I just well... woke up from whatever I was doing last night.
If I had to guess, based on how we all remember nothing. It's done on purpose.
